-- Generated by fv/kraken/gen/gen1c/emit.py for github.com/OffchainLabs/methodical-ssz/fv/kraken/target/prysm.Checkpoint. Statements only.
namespace Gen1c.Checkpoint
open Fk Fk.Code

def size_stmt [Host] : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Nat) (hk : Fk.Code.PrysmCheckpointSizeSSZ.IsInfixAt Host.prog k) (s : MachineData) (ra : UInt64)
    (R : DataMem → Prop) (h_mem : s.dmem =⋆ Eq ((Int.toBytes 8 ra.toBitVec.toInt).At s.regs.rsp.toBitVec) ⋆ R),
    Eventually (step1 Host.exe)
      (fun st => st.pc = Int64.ofBitVec ra.toBitVec ∧ st.data.regs.rax = 40 ∧ st.data.regs.rsp = s.regs.rsp + 8
        ∧ st.data.dmem = s.dmem)
      ⟨s, Host.addrOf k⟩

open Lean Meta in
#eval show MetaM Unit from do
  for (g, h) in [(``Gen1c.Checkpoint.size_stmt, ``cp_size_main), (``Gen1c.AttestationData.size_stmt, ``ad_size_main), (``Gen1c.BitVec.size_stmt, ``bv_size_main), (``Gen1c.FixedVec.size_stmt, ``fv_size_main), (``Gen1c.Scalars.size_stmt, ``sc_size_main), (``Gen1c.Checkpoint.size_stmt, ``ad_size_main)] do
    let hc ← getConstInfo h
    let gc ← getConstInfo g
    -- ∀ [inst : Host], gen inst   versus   the hand theorem's type
    let gt ← forallTelescopeReducing gc.type fun xs _ => do
      mkForallFVars xs (mkAppN (mkConst g (gc.levelParams.map mkLevelParam)) xs)
    let same ← withTransparency .all (isDefEq gt hc.type)
    IO.println s!"COMPARE {g} {h} {if same then "SAME" else "DIFF"}"
